title: TS-57 Post message with a grant, and a turn start route for enqueue_turn=false
description: From TS-53: enqueue_turn:false only creates the turn (domain/messages.ts ~192, the fence probe path) and no HTTP route starts it, so a grant-before-model flow cannot be driven over the public API; the rehearsal had to PUT the grant 0.2 s after posting (it landed before the first model.request, but the race exists). Decide and implement: either a grant field on the message post, or a start-turn route for a created-but-not-enqueued turn, with a cucumber scenario and mutation check. Also: run_terminal returns 'run_terminal:exit=N' with nothing explicit for empty output (computer/host/src/executors/terminal.ts ~155) and the model called the tool twice; make the empty-output result explicit.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14 (kept open): Not done on origin/develop. conversation/src/http/routes/messages.ts accepts enqueue_turn but no route starts a created-but-not-enqueued turn and the message post has no grant field. The run_terminal empty-output text is still 'run_terminal:exit=N' in computer/host/src/executors/terminal.ts (line 155), but that executor now serves customer-account computers only; own-account owners use Pi's bash, so the empty-output half applies to the customer path and to whatever Pi's bash returns. Left: choose grant-on-post or a start-turn route, with a scenario and mutation check.

right_now_summary: The API still cannot start unqueued turns, and empty terminal output remains unclear.
